cards.front: Can I call you back in five minutes?

audio.text: Please hold the line while I check the schedule.
Dr. Lopez is with a patient. Would you like to leave a message?

cards.text: Hi, this is Alex calling. I'd like to reschedule my appointment.
cards.tr: Здравствуйте, это Алекс. Я хотел(а) бы перенести запись.

cards.text: Sorry, you're breaking up. Could you repeat the time? And could you send me a text to confirm?
cards.tr: Извините, связь прерывается. Можете повторить время? И пришлёте СМС для подтверждения?

n1.say: Good morning, Sunrise Clinic. How can I help?
n1.tr: Доброе утро, клиника Sunrise. Чем могу помочь?

choices.text: Hi, I'm calling about my appointment on Friday. I need to reschedule.

choices.feedback: Лучше полным предложением: I'm calling about my appointment.

n2.say: Sure. Could I get your full name and date of birth?
n2.tr: Конечно. Назовите полное имя и дату рождения.

choices.text: Of course. It's Alex Petrenko, born on March third, nineteen ninety-five.
Sorry, could you speak up a bit? It's noisy here.

n3.say: Thanks. Please hold the line while I check.
n3.tr: Спасибо. Подождите на линии, я проверю.

n4.say: Thanks for holding. I can offer Tuesday at ten fifteen or Wednesday at four.
n4.tr: Спасибо за ожидание. Могу предложить вторник в 10:15 или среду в 16:00.

choices.text: Sorry, you're breaking up. Was that ten fifteen or ten fifty?
Tuesday at ten fifteen works for me.

n5.say: Ten fifteen, one-five. You're all set. We'll send you a text to confirm.
n5.tr: Десять пятнадцать, один-пять. Всё готово. Мы пришлём СМС для подтверждения.
